summary: Watch domains and forecast when they drop; check a name's domain, handles, and trademark.

toolsPreview.name: check_domains
toolsPreview.description: Check the registration status of one or more domains — whether each is taken, expiring, in redemption, in pendingDelete, or available to register. Returns status, expiry, registrar, name servers, EPP codes, and a buyer-focused drop forecast (predicted release window and confidence) for names in their lapse cycle. No authentication required. Up to 20 domains per call.

toolsPreview.name: check_name
toolsPreview.description: Name Safety Check for a brand name: domain availability across .com/.io/.ai/.app/.dev/.co, social-handle availability (best effort), and a US trademark knockout search of public USPTO records. Returns structured results. This is a knockout search, not legal advice. No authentication required.

toolsPreview.name: watch_domains
toolsPreview.description: Add one or more domains to your snooze watchlist. Each is monitored continuously and you get an email when its status changes or it nears a drop. Requires signing in to your snooze account. Up to 25 domains per call (100 total).

toolsPreview.name: unwatch_domains
toolsPreview.description: Remove one or more domains from your snooze watchlist. Requires signing in to your snooze account.

toolsPreview.name: list_watches
toolsPreview.description: List every domain on your snooze watchlist with its current status and drop forecast — so an agent can see what it is already tracking. Requires signing in to your snooze account.
